items.title: Flash flood sweeps away buildings in Nepal
items.summary: Flash flooding in Nepal has swept away buildings along the Budhi Gandaki river on Sunday.

items.title: Gagan Thapa expresses grief over Budhigandaki flood damage, urges help with rescue
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 11 Nepali Congress President Gagan Thapa has expressed grief over the severe flood in the Budhigandaki River, which caused heavy damage in Gorkha’s Chumnubri area and washed away two bridges. In a Facebook post, Thapa urged people living along the riverbanks, from the Budhigandaki down to the Trishuli, to exercise extreme caution. Noting […] The post Gagan Thapa expresses grief

items.title: What triggered the devastating flood in the Budhi Gandaki river?
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 11 A devastating flood carrying black mud and debris has struck the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha, damaging bridges and market areas just a month and a half after the Rasuwagadhi–Bhote Koshi flood. The full extent of the damage is yet to be determined. Home Minister Sudan Gurung, who was elected to Parliament […] The post What triggered the devastating flood in the Budhi Gandaki

items.title: ‘It reminded me of the Bhotekoshi floods’: Gorkha residents recount escape
items.summary: A flash flood in the Budhi Gandaki swept away houses and bridges early Sunday, forcing residents of Chumnubri and Dharche to flee to higher ground in the dark. Five people are missing, and six have been rescued by air.

items.title: Bailey bridge restores road link between Rasuwa and Nuwakot after six weeks
items.summary: A 73-metre bridge over the Phalakhu river has reopened the route between the two districts, whose road connection was severed by floods in August.

items.title: Landslide may have triggered flash flooding in Budhi Gandaki, officials say
items.summary: A landslide in Chumchet may have blocked a tributary before water surged downstream. Authorities warn of high flood risks along the Trishuli river as far as Chitwan and Nawalparasi.
